notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Priest of Gix that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
When the Priest of Gix tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding six {B}.
Repeat from step 2.
